current_claim: A local multi-protocol clinical-site workbench that reconstructs protocol lineage, authority, sponsor-separated views, exit evidence, and provider-loss packets from de-identified exports.
mechanism: Local adapters normalize structured exports into protocol, delegation, visit, assessment, booking, resource, and source-event objects while holding clinical and regulatory claims outside the product boundary.

findings.title: The current PASS is explicitly synthetic and cannot be allowed to read as clinical or regulatory validation.
findings.mechanism: A 12-cell browser self-test and static fixture checks verify internal mechanics, while actual EDC, CTMS, laboratory, delegation, and provider-loss exports remain untested.
findings.acceptance: Retain the boundary prominently and qualify a de-identified representative corpus with exact source receipts, field mappings, parser dispositions, and known omissions.

findings.title: Sponsor-separated and authority-aware views need seat-specific operational playtests.
findings.mechanism: Changing a view must alter evidence aperture, authority, next safe action, acceptance criteria, and export, rather than only filtering or relabeling the same records.
findings.acceptance: Run the same case from coordinator, PI, sponsor, monitor, and successor seats and verify materially different lawful actions over one canonical record.

findings.title: Privacy, corrupt-import, duplicate-identity, and partial-provider-loss failures need retained browser evidence.
findings.mechanism: A static local tool can still misjoin participants, overstate lineage, or expose sensitive fields when inputs are incomplete or contradictory.
findings.acceptance: Add negative fixtures, PII rejection and redaction tests, conflict-preserving joins, and cold-successor replay.

next_gate: Qualify one complete de-identified case across every seat and failure boundary without expanding the clinical claim.
